name: PM Vidyalakshmi Education Loan
description: Support for eligible students pursuing higher education through education loans from participating banks under a centralised portal.
benefit: Education loan support and interest subvention where applicable
eligibility: Students admitted to eligible higher education institutions in India. Income and institution eligibility criteria apply.
documents: Admission letter from eligible institution; Identity proof (Aadhaar/passport); Income certificate of parents/guardian; Academic records; Bank account details
how_to_apply: Register on the PM Vidyalakshmi portal (vidyalakshmi.co.in). Select participating bank and submit loan application through the portal.

name: Post Matric Scholarship
description: Financial assistance to eligible students continuing education after matriculation. Available for students from SC, ST, OBC and EWS categories.
benefit: Tuition fee reimbursement, maintenance allowance and other educational support
eligibility: Students who have passed matriculation (Class 10) and belong to SC/ST/OBC/EWS category. Family income limits and state rules apply.
documents: Caste/category certificate; Income certificate; Previous year mark sheet; Admission receipt; Bank account (preferably Aadhaar-linked); Domicile certificate
how_to_apply: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or the respective state scholarship portal during the application window.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: Health coverage for eligible families for secondary and tertiary hospital care under the world's largest government-funded health insurance scheme.
benefit: Health coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for eligible hospital treatments
eligibility: Families identified under the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) database and state-specific beneficiary lists. Check official portal for current criteria.
documents: Aadhaar card; Ration card (if applicable); SECC/beneficiary identification; State-issued health card where applicable
how_to_apply: Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or empanelled hospital. Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in using your Aadhaar or ration card.

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Income support scheme providing direct financial transfers to eligible landholding farmer families across the country.
benefit: ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly to bank accounts
eligibility: Small and marginal landholding farmer families with cultivable land parcels. Certain institutional landholders and higher income categories are excluded.
documents: Land ownership documents (Khasra/Khatauni); Aadhaar card; Bank account details with IFSC code; Mobile number linked to Aadhaar
how_to_apply: Self-register on pmkisan.gov.in (Farmers Corner) or through local agriculture department offices or Common Service Centres (CSCs).

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)
description: Housing assistance to urban beneficiaries belonging to Economically Weaker Sections (EWS), Low Income Groups (LIG), and Middle Income Groups (MIG).
benefit: Interest subsidy on housing loans under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) or central assistance for house construction/enhancement
eligibility: Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house in their name anywhere in India. Income criteria apply per category (EWS/LIG/MIG).
documents: Aadhaar card; Income certificate/salary slips; Property documents (for beneficiary-led construction); Bank account statements; Affidavit of no pucca house
how_to_apply: Apply through the official PMAY-U portal (pmaymis.gov.in) or through your municipal corporation/urban local body office.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
description: Collateral-free institutional credit to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises up to ₹10 lakh across three categories: Shishu, Kishor and Tarun.
benefit: Loans up to ₹50,000 (Shishu), ₹50,000–₹5 lakh (Kishor), and ₹5 lakh–₹10 lakh (Tarun) with affordable interest rates and no collateral requirement
eligibility: Non-farm micro and small entrepreneurs engaged in manufacturing, trading, services, or agri-allied activities needing business loans.
documents: Proof of identity (Aadhaar/Voter ID/PAN); Proof of residence; Business establishment proof; Quotations for machinery/items to be purchased; Bank account statements
how_to_apply: Apply through any public sector bank, private commercial bank, regional rural bank, or online through the Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in).

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Small savings scheme for the girl child under the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign, offering high interest rate and tax exemption under Section 80C.
benefit: Compounded annual interest rate (currently ~8.2%), tax-free interest, and tax deductions on investment under Section 80C of Income Tax Act
eligibility: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child below the age of 10 years. Maximum two accounts per family (with exceptions for twins/triplets).
documents: Girl child's birth certificate; Identity proof of depositor/parent (Aadhaar/PAN); Address proof of parent/guardian; Recent photograph of child and parent
how_to_apply: Open an account at any post office branch or authorized public/private commercial bank branch with the initial deposit form.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension
description: Monthly pension support to elderly citizens from families below poverty line under the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP).
benefit: Monthly pension amount of ₹200–₹500 (central contribution, often supplemented by state governments up to ₹1,000–₹2,500/month)
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 60 years or above living below the poverty line (BPL). Criteria may vary slightly by state.
documents: Age proof certificate (Aadhaar/voter ID/birth certificate); BPL ration card or BPL survey listing; Bank or Post Office account passbook; Passport-size photographs
how_to_apply: Apply through the Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office (rural) or District Social Welfare Office / Urban Local Body (urban), or via nsap.nic.in.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro food Enterprises
description: Financial, technical and business support to existing and aspiring micro food processing enterprises under the Aatmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan.
benefit: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost with maximum ceiling of ₹10 lakh per unit
eligibility: Existing micro food processing units, farmer producer organizations (FPOs), self-help groups (SHGs), and producer cooperatives.
documents: Aadhaar card; Bank account statements (last 6 months); Business registration or Udyam certificate; Project report/quotation for machinery; Land/building documents
how_to_apply: Submit application online on the PMFME portal (pmfme.mofpi.gov.in) through the state nodal agency or District Resource Person (DRP).

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.
benefit: Composite loan (term loan and working capital) between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore covering up to 85% of project cost with low margin money requirement
eligibility: SC/ST individuals and woman entrepreneurs above 18 years of age setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities or trading.
documents: Proof of identity; Category certificate (for SC/ST); Project report; Balance sheets/projections; Business registration; PAN card; Pollution clearances if applicable
how_to_apply: Apply online through the Stand-Up India portal (standupmitra.in) or directly through any commercial bank branch.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
description: Timely and adequate credit support to farmers for cultivation expenses, post-harvest costs, consumption needs and working capital for allied activities.
benefit: Revolving cash credit up to ₹3 lakh at a concessional interest rate of 4% (with 3% prompt repayment incentive) without collateral for loans up to ₹1.6 lakh
eligibility: All farmers (owner cultivators, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, oral lessees), self-help groups, and farmers involved in animal husbandry and fisheries.
documents: Duly filled application form; Land records (Revenue records/patta); Identity proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID); Address proof; Passport size photographs
how_to_apply: Apply at your local bank branch, Common Service Centre, or online through the respective bank's agricultural banking portal.

name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)
description: Comprehensive welfare initiative providing pensions and assistance to elderly, widows, and persons with severe disabilities living below the poverty line.
benefit: Monthly financial assistance transferred directly to beneficiary bank/post office accounts, with central and state co-contributions
eligibility: Citizens living below poverty line meeting specific category criteria: 60+ for old age pension, 40–79 for widow pension, 18+ with 80%+ disability for disability pension.
documents: BPL ration card; Age proof; Disability certificate (for disability pension); Death certificate of spouse (for widow pension); Bank account details; Aadhaar card
how_to_apply: Submit physical application to the local Village Panchayat / Block Development Office / Municipal office, or apply online at nsap.nic.in.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
description: Special micro-credit facility providing affordable working capital loans to street vendors to resume livelihoods adversely affected during economic disruptions.
benefit: Initial collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹10,000, eligible for ₹20,000 on prompt repayment, and up to ₹50,000 in third tranche, with 7% interest subsidy
eligibility: Urban and peri-urban street vendors vending before March 2020 holding Certificate of Vending or Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies.
documents: Vending Certificate or ID card; Aadhaar card; Bank account details; Mobile number linked to Aadhaar
how_to_apply: Apply through the PM SVANidhi mobile app or web portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) with assistance from local ULB or Common Service Centres.

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Maternity benefit programme providing conditional cash transfers to pregnant women and lactating mothers for health seeking and wage loss compensation.
benefit: Direct benefit transfer of ₹5,000 (first child) and ₹6,000 (second child if girl) in installments upon fulfilling health and vaccination milestones
eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for their first and second live birth (conditions apply). Women in regular government employment are excluded.
documents: MCP card (Mother and Child Protection card); Aadhaar of beneficiary and husband; Bank/post office account linked with Aadhaar; Pregnancy registration proof
how_to_apply: Register at the nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or approved government healthcare facility, or apply online via the PMMVY-CAS portal (pmmvy.wcd.gov.in).

name: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme
description: Provides practical training to technically qualified youth in industrial establishments to enhance employability and work-ready skills.
benefit: Stipend during training, practical experience and NCVT certification — amounts as per Apprentices Act rules
eligibility: Graduates, diploma holders and ITI pass-outs in relevant trade/discipline. Age and qualification criteria apply per establishment.
documents: Educational certificates (degree/diploma/ITI); Aadhaar card; Photograph; Bank account details
how_to_apply: Register at apprenticeshipindia.org. Search for training opportunities and apply through participating establishments.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship
description: Scholarships for meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest dropout at Class VIII level and encourage continuation of secondary education.
benefit: ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) for Classes IX to XII
eligibility: Students who qualify the NMMS examination in Class VIII. Annual parental income not more than ₹3.5 lakh. Must secure minimum 55% in Class VII.
documents: NMMS examination admit card/score; Class VII mark sheet; Income certificate; Aadhaar card; Bank account details; School enrollment certificate
how_to_apply: Apply through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) after qualifying the state-level NMMS examination.
